unitEvidence: Invalid queries, copied inputs, retired late results and saved closures, storage failures, live/loading/persisted/unknown positions and finished/expository policies are covered by domain tests.
Pure graph tests cover hidden aliases/notes, generic miss, flavor mismatch, chapter result isolation, overlapping entity queries and 200-entity/40-edge limits.
Agent metadata failure propagates instead of swallowing an exception and skipping spoiler protection.
Memory Desk tests cover explicit scopes, 40-book page clamping, chapter form validation, provenance recheck, missing href, errors, overview/profile truncation and eight locales.
captureBoundary: Initial three captures show graph, retained detail/localized read failure and actual FB2 text. No horizontal overflow at 800. Repeat personal screenshot captured loading, not the final result; final personal-memory success is supported by later DOM text, not that image.

cleanup.memoryPolicy: Forgotten through canonical events, not physically erased; isolated test event history remains.
cleanup.firstAttempt: Vite optimized a new dynamic path import and reloaded during initial seed preparation. The first owned book was removed by exact ID/title check; it was not counted as successful E2E. Later stable runs succeeded.

validation.build: Frontend production build and explicit Memory Desk build passed, including the overview truncation presentation; final commands all terminated successfully.

documents.drawerAndTheme: Matrix/model mobile drawer toggled main.inert; dark/light class and saved preference persisted across reload/navigation. Plugin-system has neither control.
documents.audit: No document horizontal overflow, duplicate IDs, broken fragment anchors, unnamed buttons or browser errors; observed CDN responses were 200. No diagrams added.
documents.boundary: Documentation verification is not product runtime verification.

boundaries: memory:read grants all memory scopes; query filtering is not per-book/field authority. No memory writes or observers are exposed.
Search has a 100-result limit without cursor/exhaustion, graph 200 entities and 40 edges/profile; neither proves general byte-bounded chapter payloads or full large-data UX.
chapterHref is not content-versioned. Visibility recheck does not validate old digests against replaced source bytes. Agent prompt assembly is a separate consumer not proved flavor-consistent here.

Plugin graph policy uses current/persisted reading position; Agent global/cross-book policy intentionally remains different. Runtime lifecycle tests discard late replies, not physically cancel SQLite.

No packaged, Windows/Linux, all-format, full consent upgrade, autonomous inference, long-running concurrency or complete privacy campaign was performed. Native bridge/version, startup WebView and build chunk warnings remain.
